paragraphs: He was a student of R' Eliezer (Eruvin 63a), for he issued a halakhic ruling in the presence of his teacher, and R' Eliezer said to his wife that he would not live out his year, and so it was.[^1]

notes.text: The headed student is the natural implicit subject of not living out his year, supported by the ruling and and-so-it-was outcome. Hyman reports the prediction and outcome, not a fresh verified death record. גוריא versus machine נוריא remains provenance. ר״א is contextually Eliezer from the preceding explicit name but not a full title; both teacher titles remain R'. The heading has no title and gains none from catalog רבי. סג. gives 63a by convention without new passage verification.
